text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0847, Resolution]
ADOPT the Resolutions of Necessity authorizing the commencement of eminent domain actions to acquire property interests, including easements and Improvements Pertaining to Realty (IPR), from the properties identified in Attachment A and described as follows:

1.	Vacant Land, S.E. Corner of Imperial Hwy & Mona Blvd, Lynwood, CA 90262; APN 6150-037-045; CPN: 86906-1 (24-month Temporary Construction Easement, 2,384 square feet); CPN: 86906-2 (Permanent Aerial Easement, 37 square feet); and CPN: 86906-3 (Permanent Aerial Easement, 206 square feet); IPR Interest (Billboard); and

2.	2900 Fernwood Avenue, Lynwood, CA 90262; APN: 6169-002-013; CPN: 86909; IPR Interest (Billboard).

The interests being acquired in the above-listed properties are referred to herein as the “Property Interests.”

(REQUIRES TWO-THIRDS VOTE OF THE FULL BOARD)
